definitions: To intentionally make a place dark by turning off all lights, especially for safety during a war.
To censor or obscure part of a text or image.
To suffer a temporary loss of memory.
examples: She blacked out during the ceremony.
The city blacked out all its lights during the air raid.
The names of the informants were blacked out in the report.
He blacked out the last few minutes of the accident.
